items.title: MTV's Celebrity Deathmatch [PS2, 2003]: Licensed Video Games #041
items.description: Our second episode of the week sees us looking at another Big Ape Productions game, Celebrity Deathmatch. Yes, it's another wrestling game. Yes, it controls in a similar sort of fashion. Having re-watched some Celebrity Deathmatch online, this really doesn't have the same kind of charm as the show.

items.title: PSX Longplay [327] MTV Celebrity Deathmatch
items.description:
What a load of crap this game is. A complete waste of time and a pure cash in shovelware taking advantage of fans of the series.

The presentation is pretty minimal and not a lot to connect the game with the series.  Probably the only thing in common is the announcers Nick Diamond and Jonny Gomez.
